title: Preparation of forcing lines

D0.outcome: Explains that preparation means exact recall of forcing lines where one lapse loses, and understanding of the structures elsewhere.

D1.outcome: For his own repertoire, lists the forcing lines that need exact recall and the lines that need only understanding, with the reason.

D2.outcome: Recalls forcing lines after spaced intervals and handles a transposition into another line.

D3.outcome: Prepares for a specific opponent from the data: finds the deviations to check and a prepared reply.

misconceptions: More memorised moves is better preparation.
sources: docs/council-synthesis.md CD-7, Round 7 (retrieval and spacing suit forced lines; understanding precedes memorising)
conditions: Retrieval and spacing apply to forcing lines only.
Understanding openings beats memorising them for a learner who already calculates; opening analysis is rated too highly as a study method.
contrasts: Memorising a line without a model position.
Spaced review applied to non-forcing lines.
